channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Beyond Embedded: How DuckDB v2.0 Shifts Architecture Toward Distributed Network Capabilities
item.description: DuckDB Labs has previewed DuckDB v2.0, codenamed "Cyanoptera." This release includes over 10000 commits and introduces a client/server mode, enabling network connections. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: distributed identity
item.description: Git makes it stupidly hard to change or hide your identity (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: The Cloudflare Blog – Brought to you by EmDash
item.description: We migrated the Cloudflare Blog to EmDash to prove our stack at massive scale. Here is how we stress-tested performance, safely routed production traffic, and redesigned the frontend experience. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Five monetization trends from global pricing leaders
item.description: As AI transforms software economics, the standard revenue playbook is breaking down. (1 source: stripe)

item.title: Microsoft Moves AI Governance From Policy to Runtime Enforcement
item.description: Microsoft has outlined an AI governance architecture spanning nine governance domains and four functions: policy, control, visibility, and proof. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: I cannot survive from burnout
item.description: I burned out two years ago, went through a divorce, and relocated to a new city. I live alone now and care for seven cats. Over the last two years, I’ve tried forcing discipline, making detailed plans, and restarting over and over. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Your alt text passes automated checks. That doesn’t mean it’s any good.
item.description: We built a plugin for the GitHub Accessibility Scanner to make sure your alt text is actually accessible. Here's how it works. The post Your alt text passes automated checks. That doesn’t mean it’s any good. (1 source: githubblog)
